name: Homelab & Tinkering
description: Self-hosted everything, unreasonable uptime expectations, and yes, another dotfiles rewrite
extendedDescription:
My homelab is a permanent work-in-progress. I run a cluster of self-hosted services — media, monitoring, reverse proxies, DNS, and a few things that exist purely because I wanted to understand them. Kubernetes at home? Yes, and it broke spectacularly the first three times.

I have an obsession with making workflows faster and cleaner. Dotfiles, shell configs, editor setups, automation scripts — I'll happily spend an evening eliminating ten seconds from a task I do twice a week. It's not always rational but it's consistently satisfying.

Beyond the homelab, I follow the broader industry closely: new language features, architectural patterns, platform engineering trends. I try to stay genuinely curious rather than just chasing hype.
